about: Revelation is the last book of the Bible. It tells how Jesus wins and makes everything new.

pages.title: Jesus at the Door
pages.text: Jesus said, "Look! I am standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with them as a friend."

pages.title: Worship in Heaven
pages.scene: God's throne with a rainbow and people singing
pages.text: John saw God's throne in heaven with a rainbow around it. Angels and people from every nation sang, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God!" They praised Jesus, the Lamb, who saved people from every language and land.
pages.lesson: People everywhere will praise God together.

pages.title: Everything New
pages.scene: A river of life with a tree beside it
pages.text: At the end, God will make a new heaven and a new earth. He will wipe every tear away. No more crying, no more pain! There will be a river of life and a tree with fruit for everyone. Jesus says, "I am coming soon!"
